name: RBZ Jewellers Ltd
title: RBZ Jewellers Ltd - 544060 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gold jeweller with no FY27 guidance; capacity utilisation only 50-55%, management says no manufacturing capex needed, while two large and two mid-format stores need ~INR125-150 crore inventory each, debt rising to ~1:1.2.

utilisation.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capex.quote: I think right now, we are not looking for any kind of capex in manufacturing setup.

triggers.label: Utilisation ~50-55%, no mfg capex
triggers.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

triggers.label: Trade receivables 17 to 56 crore
triggers.quote: our trade receivables have jumped like from 17 to 56

triggers.label: No FY27 guidance given
triggers.quote: There is no guidance for this year, frankly saying.

triggers.label: Gold price up; ~3-4 pt inventory gain assumed
triggers.quote: assuming that around INR10 crores to INR12 crores or INR10 crores to INR11 crores or INR12 crores should be an inventory gain number

guidance.quote: There is no guidance for this year, frankly saying.
both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Q4 revenue growth in line with prior guidance
prior_guidance_check.quote: revenue growth broadly in line with the guidance and expectations shared with investors in the previous quarter

red_flags.label: Receivables jumped 17 to 56 crore; mgmt cites exhibition-driven spike
red_flags.quote: our trade receivables have jumped like from 17 to 56

red_flags.label: Gold inventory on balance sheet funded by short-term debt (INR120 crore); peak debt 1:1.2
red_flags.quote: INR120 crores are in short-term debt?

red_flags.label: Inventory gains undisclosed; PAT ex-gains guided loosely as INR40-45 crore
red_flags.quote: somewhere around INR40 crores, INR45 crores should be the PAT

red_flags.label: Management declined FY27 guidance; evasive on Surat/Rajkot sales ramp
red_flags.quote: we would really not give out the guidance for this year

evasions.quote: I think in the scenarios like this, we would really not give out the guidance for this year.
currently, I do not have a number on it.
this is too much a nascent kind of a stage wherein we would comment anything.
